title: Regulation of proton transference for stable and efficient reactive capture of CO<sub>2</sub> from air
abstract: Published online: 27 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02158-8 Direct air capture integrated with electrosynthesis to produce fuels and chemicals is hindered by high energy consumption and limited operational lifetimes. Here the authors identify proton management as crucial for stability and achieve 1,000 h of stable operation by using gas-fed hydrogen oxidation at the anode, which maintains ideal ion transport and enhances CO production.

title: Dual-cation solvation-tailored electrolyte solutions for low-temperature 48-V/30-Ah lithium-ion battery modules
abstract: Published online: 27 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41565-026-02339-2 A non-aqueous electrolyte solution forms a hierarchical primary solvation sheath with a dual-Li+ inner core, enabling stable Li-based battery operation down to −50 °C across coin cells and Ah-scale modules with different electrode chemistries.
